issues.text: Scrollback (past saved memories above the live thread) renders as full-width white summary cards (56px thumb + title + date) rather than the spec's chat bubble format (radius 18, sender corner 12, max width 78%). Reads as a list view stitched above the thread instead of the thread itself; either restyle these as narrower bubbles or, if they're intentionally a distinct 'history' element, note that decision in ARCHITECTURE.md so it stops reading as a spec deviation.

notes: Quick round 2: gauntlet capture --quick, 5 shots, 0 console/page errors, 0 failed requests, readyMs 1115-1290.
